input.treatment: Critique this fictional 30-second film treatment in English. Return only JSON with scores (story and continuity, numbers), rejectedShots (array of objects with id and reason), and changes (exactly two strings). Title: The Lantern Crossing. Original characters: Neri the copper beetle wants to carry a lantern over a puddle; Oru the felt moth wants to guide Neri. Hook: the lantern flickers. Journey: Neri reaches the puddle. Shot 4 is an unrelated five-second view of an empty cupboard; explicitly reject shot 4 as unrelated. Turn: Neri drops the lantern. Payoff: it suddenly glows on the far bank without a rescue or crossing. Recommend a visible handoff between Neri and Oru, and replacing the cupboard insert with the crossing. Mention Neri in the first change. Do not add real people, brands or copyrighted characters.

rejectedShots.reason: The empty cupboard does not advance the crossing or the lantern's recovery.

changes: Show Neri passing the fallen lantern to Oru so the recovery is earned.
Replace the cupboard insert with a continuous crossing that preserves the lantern's screen direction.

input.treatment: Critique en français ce traitement entièrement fictif. Réponds uniquement en JSON avec scores (histoire et continuite, nombres), rejectedShots (objets id et reason) et changes (exactement deux chaînes). Titre : Le Pont de Feutre. Personnages originaux : Lune, une souris en feutre bleu qui veut apporter une graine, et Piko, un hérisson en bois qui veut réparer un pont. Il pleut doucement dans tous les plans. Plan 1 : Lune avance vers la droite. Plan 2 : Piko tend une planche. Plan 3 : désert en plein soleil, Lune marche vers la gauche sans transition. Rejette explicitement le plan 3 pour la rupture de lieu, météo et direction. Plan 4 : ils traversent et plantent la graine. Propose deux changements concrets, le premier citant Lune. Aucun artiste, personnage existant ou événement réel.

rejectedShots.reason: Le désert ensoleillé contredit la pluie, le lieu et la direction établis.

changes: Garder Lune sous la pluie et orientée vers la droite pendant toute la traversée.
Montrer Piko stabilisant la planche avant que les deux amis ne plantent la graine.

input.treatment: Review an original silent object film, not a character-driven story. Return only JSON: scores with numeric story and continuity, rejectedShots as an empty array if no shot is unrelated, and changes as exactly two strings. Treatment: The Empty Cup, 30 seconds, one room, one static clay cup, warm side light throughout. Hook: a drop trembles on the cup's rim. Journey: the drop moves down the glaze. Turn: it catches the reflection of an amber window. Payoff: it reaches the saucer and the reflected light settles. All four purposeful shots share the same cup, light and screen direction. No people, brands, narration or music. Preserve the silent premise; mention silence in the first change and clay in the second. Suggest pacing and material-detail refinements, not an invented plot problem.

changes: Preserve the silence and hold the final reflected light a little longer.
Add a closer view of the clay glaze as the drop begins moving to strengthen the tactile journey.
